chapter: Reel two to four: pay, tailgate and style
title: Hotel rooms and nightclubs: the Cave
summary: He describes a hotel nightclub on Baronne Street and The Cave with its big revues.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about... You mentioned the Grunewald Hotel. What kind of rooms did they have in there? Different places to play. Well, uh...
You know on Barone Street where the restaurant is? Yeah. The Roastoff Hotel. That was a kind of, you know, nightclub there, see? Is that the Forest Grill? No. Where was the Forest Grill?
I'm sorry. No, I can't remember. You can't remember the name?
I can't remember the name. But anyhow, that was the place. You know, for all the good people in the class, used to go there. Then we played The Cave. Did you ever see The Cave, Dick?
No, it's still there, they tell me, but I've never been there.

Well, they used to have big reviews, like Rainey Young from Chicago, New York, you know. They'd bring about 15 gallons and big shows, like Singers and Acrobatic and everything, you know. But it was a beautiful place down there.
